title: Mini-case: Pixelwerk games studio
text: Pixelwerk (180 employees) has two groups: a small R&D team that invents new game concepts, and a large live-ops team that maintains existing games, fixes bugs and runs events. Everyone is rated once a year on lines of code, tickets closed and deadlines met, and ranked on a forced curve: the bottom 10 % get no raise and are put on improvement plans.

Over two years no new game concept has been launched; R&D engineers say they avoid risky ideas because failed experiments “look bad” in the rating, and live-ops engineers have stopped helping each other before reviews.
